data.explanation: This is your policy confirmation for home contents insurance. Cover begins on 1 October 2026 for a one-year term. The contract renews by one year each time unless you cancel in text form (Textform, e.g. email or letter) at least three months before the end of the insurance year. The first premium of €96.60 will be collected by direct debit at the start date, so make sure your account has enough funds. The app tracks the cancellation deadline for you. Keep this document for your records.
